summary: Comprehensive testing of WebAuthn biometric authentication and persistent login features. All 17 backend tests passed. All frontend UI tests passed. Fixed a critical bug in server.py (jwt.JWTError -> jwt.exceptions.PyJWTError).
context_for_next_testing_agent: WebAuthn and persistent login features are fully implemented and tested. Actual biometric verification requires real Face ID/Touch ID hardware and cannot be automated.

login_with_remember_me.details: Login with Remember Me checked stores token in localStorage. Token is a valid JWT format.

token_expiration_30_days.details: JWT token expiration is set to 30 days (verified via ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES=43200 and JWT payload inspection)

persistent_login_no_flash.details: Revisiting the app with valid token goes straight to dashboard with loading state - no login screen flash

logout_clears_token.details: Logout clears token, user, webauthn_email, and webauthn_registered from localStorage

webauthn_register_options_endpoint.details: /api/auth/webauthn/register-options returns valid WebAuthn registration options (requires auth)

auth_me_endpoint.details: /api/auth/me returns user info including has_webauthn field

remember_me_checkbox_default.details: Login page shows 'Remember me on this device' checkbox, checked by default

biometric_login_ui.details: When webauthn_registered=true in localStorage, login page shows 'Sign in with Face ID' button

password_fallback.details: Password form is accessible via 'Use password instead' link, email is pre-filled

session_storage_without_remember_me.details: When Remember Me is unchecked, token goes to sessionStorage instead of localStorage

bugs_fixed.fix: Changed jwt.JWTError to jwt.exceptions.PyJWTError and added generic Exception handler

notes: WebAuthn actual biometric verification (Face ID/Touch ID) cannot be tested in automation as it requires real hardware. The UI flows and backend endpoints have been verified to work correctly.
